name: Photovoltaic inverter
summary: A photovoltaic inverter converts a documented PV DC input into an AC output and provides the selected PV control functions.
description: A photovoltaic inverter converts a documented PV DC input into an AC output and provides the selected PV control functions. Its schematic keeps DC strings, AC connection and control/protection interfaces distinct.
readingNotes: Check the number of documented MPPT inputs rather than assuming all DC terminals share one tracker.

distinction: A PV inverter is different from a battery converter even when both connect to the same AC bus.
